labelChirho: gentleness, meekness (as a virtue or fruit of the Spirit)
descriptionChirho: The quality of being gentle, mild, and meek in character and conduct, frequently listed as a fruit of the Spirit or a characteristic expected of believers. Cross-linguistic evidence is unanimous: Spanish 'mansedumbre' (meekness), Arabic 'wadāʿa' (gentleness/meekness), Korean '온유함' (gentleness), Swahili 'upole' (gentleness/mildness), Hindi 'नरमता/नम्रता' (softness/humility). The two clusters are split purely by grammatical case (genitive vs other oblique cases) with identical semantic content across all attestations.
